label: private customer RFP and contract corpus (208 documents, 105 cases)
notes: Retrieval settings are the repository defaults (recorded under retrieval); ranks are by relevance (best chunk score). The first baseline ranked by position, which retrieval returns alphabetically, and ran with a maintainer's local app_state.json overrides; both are corrected here.
Cases drafted by mistral, reviewed and corrected by an AI assistant (claude), approved by the maintainer; not human-verified case by case.

Calibration grades are an AI assistant's (38 of 40) plus 2 by the maintainer, taken on the previous run's answers with the same judge; they characterise the judge, not these exact answers. Human calibration (ROADMAP P2-3) was deferred by the maintainer.

Judge v1 overstates answer_correct (bias +0.21 and +0.30 on two sheets); judge v2 is near-unbiased on correct (-0.03) and scored the 2026-09-30 answers 0.514: the chat answers correctly about half the time. v1 is kept as the baseline judge for consistency; use its judged metrics to detect regressions, not as absolute quality.
On the 2026-09-30 run, retrieval misses concentrated in office formats: the source document was not retrieved for 76% of Excel, 67% PowerPoint and 52% Word questions, against 20% for PDF.

Re-baselined 2026-10-05 after #422 made the lexical arm fire (it ANDed every word of the question): against the 2026-09-30 baseline, source_recall@5 +0.028, source_mrr +0.013, proof_recall +0.019, citation_correct +0.029, answer_correct +0.062 (the v1 judge, so read as a direction, not a size), faithfulness -0.023. Same models, judge prompt and retrieval settings.
